## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `./gradlew build` succeeds.
- [ ] The change was tested in a Minecraft 1.21.1 development client or server when applicable.
- [ ] Temporary effects are cleaned up when an event or session stops.
- [ ] No generated output, local run files or third-party JARs are included.

## Gameplay impact

Describe any changes to blocks, gamerules, inventories, mobs, dimensions or player positions.
